__comment: Leaveout route. GLIMPSE2_concordance reads '<region> <frequencies> <truth> <imputed>', and this workflow passes the panel as both frequencies and truth. That is exactly right here: the held-out samples' assembly-based genotypes live in the FULL panel and nowhere else. truth_vcfs is left UNSET so it defaults to panel_vcfs.
__comment_panel: The FULL panel -- frequencies AND truth. Imputation upstream used the LEAVEOUT panel. Pointing this at the leaveout panel too is the mistake that makes the result look perfect.
